question: Which MUTCD table gives a fixed replacement interval, in years, for every type of traffic sign?
model_answer: Direct Answer: No such table exists in the evidence provided. None of the MUTCD tables in the supplied material prescribes a fixed replacement interval, in years, for traffic signs. The tables shown address other subjects entirely — recommended letter/numeral sizes (Table 2D-2), advance warning sign spacing (Table 6B-1), FHWA target compliance dates for specific provisions (Table 1B-1), and sign size dimensions (Tables 2H-1, 2I-1, 6H-1). The evidence is insufficient to identify any table matching the question's description, and the premise of the question appears to be mistaken. Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Table 2D-2, which gives recommended minimum letter and numeral sizes for guide signs by speed — not replacement intervals. [Image 3] shows Table 6B-1, which gives recommended minimum spacing distances (in feet) between advance warning signs by road type — not replacement intervals. [Image 4] shows Table 1B-1, which lists FHWA target compliance dates for specific new provisions — these are one-time compliance deadlines, not recurring sign replacement intervals. [Image 2] shows Figure 6B-1, a diagram of temporary traffic control zone components, unrelated to sign replacement. [Images 5–8] show sign size tables, a signs figure, and tables of contents, none of which address replacement intervals. Citations: - Table 2D-2 (p.210) - Table 6B-1 (p.773) - Table 1B-1 (p.5) - Section 1B.03 Support §9 (p.6)
